findings.issue: Feature-flag routes reference requireWorkspaceMembership('workspaceId') but no :workspaceId param exists in route path — every request returns 400
findings.impact: Feature flags completely non-functional; all workspace feature-flag operations silently fail
findings.fix: Remove requireWorkspaceMembership or add workspaceId as a body/query parameter

findings.issue: API env schema uses EMAIL_FROM while shared packages/config/env-schema.ts uses SMTP_FROM — same purpose, different env var names
findings.impact: Operators may set SMTP_FROM expecting it to be read, but API reads EMAIL_FROM and falls back silently
findings.fix: Standardize on a single name (EMAIL_FROM), update shared schema to match

findings.issue: Web env schema missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME — all used in code but not validated
findings.impact: Version badge shows '0.0.0-dev' and 'local' in production; Sentry not configured on frontend
findings.fix: Add missing vars to apps/web/lib/env.ts Zod schema

findings.issue: Terraform state key is hardcoded with no environment interpolation — same state key for dev and prod
findings.impact: Parallel dev and prod Terraform operations corrupt each other's state
findings.fix: Use ${var.environment} in state key to isolate environments

findings.issue: Runbook references packages/db/sql/migrations/ directory which no longer exists — all migrations consolidated under supabase/migrations/
findings.impact: Operators following runbook will look in wrong directory for migration files
findings.fix: Update runbook to reference supabase/migrations/ as the single source of migrations

findings.issue: Duplicate policy file sets exist: docs/hardening_super_bundle/policies/ and docs/audits/policies/ — risk of drift
findings.impact: Policy changes may be applied to one set but not the other; inconsistent gating
findings.fix: Consolidate to single source of truth (hardening/policies/) and remove duplicates

findings.issue: Migration sequence gap in 20260626 batch — jumps from 01 to 22 suggesting deleted or renumbered migrations
findings.impact: Potential confusion about migration history; Supabase CLI tracking may conflict
findings.fix: Audit migration sequence; renumber or add placeholder files to fill gaps

findings.issue: Webhook GET route reads workspace_id from query param but middleware checks req.params.workspaceId — they never match
findings.impact: Webhook listing bypasses workspace membership check via query param
findings.fix: Create middleware that reads from req.query.workspace_id instead of req.params

findings.issue: Production Caddyfile missing API subdomain block for chat-api.mainecybertech.com — DNS record exists but Caddy does not serve it
findings.impact: Wasted DNS record; direct API subdomain access gets no response
findings.fix: Remove unused DNS record or add Caddy site block for completeness

findings.issue: Default droplet size still s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb despite known OOM issues — AGENTS.md documents upgrade to s-2vcpu-2gb
findings.impact: New dev droplets provisioned with undersized spec will experience OOM
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in terraform variables.tf

findings.issue: Stale index (2).md file found in dashboard directory — appears to be a duplicate from a copy conflict
findings.impact: Git tracking noise; confusing for maintainers
